department: School of Earth and Atmospheric Sciences

deadline.value: EAS gives 1 January as the application deadline; the Georgia Tech portal lists 5 January 2027 for the Fall 2027 PhD. Review starts mid-January.
deadline.quote: it is important that prospective students contact potential advisors to determine if their research interests and backgrounds are aligned well before the application deadline: January 1.

also.quote: Earth & Atmospheric Science Earth and Atmospheric Sciences Sciences Atlanta Doctoral Fall 2026 Fall 2027 01/05/2026 01/05/2027

gre_general.quote: The GRE is not required for our program.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Contact potential advisors well before the deadline to check fit; admitted students get a temporary advisor and choose a permanent one by the end of the first semester.
supervisor.quote: it is important that prospective students contact potential advisors to determine if their research interests and backgrounds are aligned well before the application deadline

also.quote: All incoming students are assigned to a temporary faculty advisor until the end of the first semester.

funding.value: All enrolled graduate students receive financial support, normally a GRA or GTA; the EAS stipend is USD 37,500 a year with tuition paid. Admission is competitive because it is limited by assistantships (about 10-15 admits a year).
funding.quote: All enrolled graduate students will receive financial support (see financial assistance for details). | Our admission process is highly competitive because the number of graduate students we can admit is limited by the availability of assistantships.

also.quote: The current EAS stipend for its graduate students is $37,500, or $3,125.00 per month, and includes tuition payment.

entry_route.value: The EAS pages fetched do not say whether a master's is needed before the PhD.

notes: EAS covers geology/geophysics, atmospheric science, oceanography and planetary science. First-year students must TA a lab section in their first semester. Georgia Tech also runs an interdisciplinary Ocean Science & Engineering PhD (portal deadline 5 January 2027).
